dct_title_s: Satellite detected landslide extent in Hanang District, Manyara Region, Tanzania as of 07 December 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: LS20231208TZA** This map illustrates satellite detected landslides in Hanang District, Manyara Region, Tanzania as observed from a Sentinel-2 acquired on 07 December 2023 at 11:11 local time. Within the analyzed area of 4,000 ha, about 75 ha of landslides scars are observed. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
